chatgpt.ai.description: Displayed in other strings when showGPTName option is disabled. e.g., 'AI is responding...'

chatgpt.aiResponding.description: Displayed when the AI is generating a response. {0} will be replaced with the AI's name. e.g., 'ChatGPT is responding...'

chatgpt.conversationStats.description: Displayed to show the number of times the user asked a question and total words used, e.g., 'asked 3 times | 150 words'.

chatgpt.exploreGPTs.description: Displayed when the user is exploring different GPT models category.

chatgpt.pricing.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the pricing page.

chatgpt.settings.description: Displayed when the user is viewing their ChatGPT settings

chatgpt.spaceImages.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing images in their space.

chatgpt.spacePages.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing pages in their space.

chatgpt.spacePresentations.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing presentations in their space.

chatgpt.spaceSharedWithMe.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing items shared with them in their space.

chatgpt.spaceSites.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing sites in their space.

chatgpt.spaceSpreadsheets.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing spreadsheets in their space.

chatgpt.spaceTrash.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing the trash in their space.

chatgpt.spaceYourItems.description: Displayed as the state when the user is viewing their own items in their space.

chatgpt.startNewConversation.description: Displayed when the user is starting a new conversation.

chatgpt.startNewConversationInTemporaryC.description: Displayed when the user is starting a new conversation in a temporary chat.
chatgpt.startNewConversationInTemporaryC.message: Start new conversation in temporary chat

chatgpt.talkingWithAI.description: Displayed when the user is engaging in a conversation with the AI. {0} will be replaced with the AI's name. e.g., 'Talking with ChatGPT about something'

chatgpt.talkingWithAIInSharedChat.description: Displayed when the user is engaging in a shared chat with the AI. {0} will be replaced with the AI's name. e.g., 'Talking with ChatGPT about something in a shared chat'
chatgpt.talkingWithAIInSharedChat.message: Talking with {0} about something in a shared chat

chatgpt.talkingWithAIInTemporaryChat.description: Displayed when the user is engaging in a temporary chat with the AI. {0} will be replaced with the AI's name. e.g., 'Talking with ChatGPT about something in temporary chat'
chatgpt.talkingWithAIInTemporaryChat.message: Talking with {0} about something in temporary chat

chatgpt.thinkingOfPrompt.description: Displayed when the user is thinking of a new prompt.

chatgpt.viewingGPT.description: Displayed when the user is viewing a specific GPT model.

chatgpt.viewingAGPT.description: Displayed when the user is viewing a GPT model.

chatgpt.viewingImage.description: Displayed when the user is viewing an image. {0} will be replaced with the image name.

chatgpt.viewingImages.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the images page.

chatgpt.viewingLibrary.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the library.

chatgpt.viewingMaps.description: Displayed when the user is viewing maps.

chatgpt.viewingMyGPTs.description: Displayed when the user is viewing their own GPTs.

chatgpt.viewingPlugin.description: Displayed when the user is viewing a specific plugin. The plugin name will be displayed as the state.

chatgpt.viewingPlugins.description: Displayed when the user is viewing the plugins directory.

chatgpt.viewingProfile.description: Displayed when the user is viewing a profile. The profile name will be displayed as the state.

chatgpt.viewingProjects.description: Displayed when the user is viewing projects.

chatgpt.viewingScheduledTasks.description: Displayed when the user is viewing scheduled tasks.

chatgpt.viewingSkills.description: Displayed when the user is viewing skills.

chatgpt.viewingSpace.description: Displayed when the user is viewing their space.
